QA-05.root_cause: assert_not_final100_path previously checked only direct filenames/suffixes and missed copied or renamed files; assert_not_final100_scenario did not validate scenario_id prefix vs fixture_label.
QA-05.solution: assert_not_final100_path resolves symlinks and computes LF-normalized SHA256 on existing files to reject c03bc6dc300604ac395505d59b6413c1a47339b21408cfd637671e81d4b555a1 (final100) and 0aa9ae923d0e7f29df49735fa41e87530b1caf62418fcbec09a1eff81d83af62 (P11); assert_not_final100_scenario enforces W06-DEV-TUNE-* -> W06_DEV_TUNE and W06-DEV-SELECT-* -> W06_DEV_SELECT.

QA-14.root_cause: execute_dev_cell_with_mock_transport fell back to parse_strict_benchmark_plan_response when BenchmarkPlanResponse.model_validate failed, synthesizing missing plan_id, scenario_id, destination_slug, day_cost, and budget_analysis.
QA-14.solution: Removed parse_strict_benchmark_plan_response import and fallback from dev_selection_harness.py; implemented parse_primary_dev_plan_response enforcing strict raw_text -> json.loads -> required keys check (including day_cost) -> BenchmarkPlanResponse.model_validate with zero field synthesis.

QA-15.root_cause: execute_dev_cell_with_mock_transport substituted missing returned_model_id with requested_model_id, and aggregate_dev_cell_receipts, select_winning_prompt_dev_tune, and select_winning_candidate_dev_select did not halt on MODEL_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH.
QA-15.solution: Removed returned_model_id fallback substitution; classified missing/empty or incompatible returned_model_id as MODEL_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH (counts_in_denominator=False, batch_stop_required=True); added assert_batch_receipts_integrity raising ModelIntegrityBatchStopError across batch execution, aggregation, and DEV-TUNE/DEV-SELECT selection.

QA-27.root_cause: MockProviderTransportResponse and DevCellExecutionReceipt lacked thought_tokens and cache token fields, and execute_dev_cell_with_mock_transport did not pass thought_tokens to compute_canonical_cell_cost_usd.
QA-27.solution: Added thought_tokens, reasoning_tokens, thinking_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, raw_usage_metadata, and latency_ns to MockProviderTransportResponse and DevCellExecutionReceipt; for C1 (Google), compute_canonical_cell_cost_decimal bills output_tokens + thought_tokens once.

QA-28.root_cause: compute_canonical_cell_cost_usd blindly added thought_or_reasoning_tokens to output_tokens for all candidates, double-counting OpenAI reasoning_tokens (C2) and Anthropic thinking_tokens (C3) which are already included in output_tokens.
QA-28.solution: Made compute_canonical_cell_cost_decimal and compute_canonical_cell_cost_usd candidate-aware: C1 bills output_tokens + thought_tokens; C2 and C3 bill output_tokens only while recording reasoning_tokens/thinking_tokens for observability; nonzero unsupported cache tokens return None (non-comparable).

QA-29.root_cause: _to_exact_decimal formatted floats via f'{value:.12f}', truncating/rounding differences beyond 12 decimal places during Criterion 4 cost tiebreaks.
QA-29.solution: Replaced _to_exact_decimal with exact Decimal(str(value)) conversion without formatting precision caps, preserving full unrounded Decimal precision in compute_canonical_cell_cost_decimal, aggregate median cost, and Criterion 4 tiebreaks.

QA-30.root_cause: Criterion 5 median latency tiebreak used the 12-decimal-truncated _to_exact_decimal helper.
QA-30.solution: Criterion 5 latency tiebreak compares unrounded Decimal(str(value)) median latencies with zero rounding and zero epsilon.

QA-32.root_cause: Single-prompt DEV-TUNE returned SINGLE_PROMPT_P1_LOCKED_WITHOUT_COMPARISON instead of Method Lock's LOCK_P1_WITHOUT_PERFORMANCE_COMPARISON, and no fail-closed verifier existed for a separate frozen prompt artifact before live execution.
QA-32.solution: Set SINGLE_PROMPT_P1_LOCK_STATUS = 'LOCK_P1_WITHOUT_PERFORMANCE_COMPARISON' and added DevPromptFreezeArtifact, build_dev_prompt_freeze_artifact, verify_prompt_candidate_freeze_artifact, and assert_prompt_freeze_before_live.

QA-33.root_cause: DevCellExecutionManifest and DevCellExecutionReceipt lacked code_commit_sha and provider_config_sha256, and execute_dev_cell_with_mock_transport hardcoded EXPECTED_BASE_DEVELOP_SHA_DEV_HARNESS into BenchmarkRunManifest.
QA-33.solution: Added validated 40-hex code_commit_sha and 64-hex provider_config_sha256 to DevCellExecutionManifest and DevCellExecutionReceipt, and propagated cell_manifest.code_commit_sha into BenchmarkRunManifest.

QA-39.root_cause: DevCellFailureClassification lacked PARTIAL_TIMEOUT and HARNESS_INTERNAL_ERROR, and batch-stop failures were not separated from ordinary denominator-preserving failures.
QA-39.solution: Added PARTIAL_TIMEOUT (counts_in_denominator=True, batch_stop_required=False) and HARNESS_INTERNAL_ERROR (counts_in_denominator=False, batch_stop_required=True) to DevCellFailureClassification and enforced HarnessInternalBatchStopError and ModelIntegrityBatchStopError via assert_batch_receipts_integrity.
